feature.name: Engaging Visual Quiz Games
feature.description: Transform text-only quizzes into visually-rich, level-appropriate game experiences for K-12 students

goals: Make quizzes more engaging with visual diagrams from learning content
Adapt question types to explanation level (Simple/Standard/Deep)
Add gamification elements (streaks, XP scaling, celebrations)
Reward harder challenges with more XP
